macros.name: acmISBN
macros.doc: Book-like volumes have ISBN numbers attached to them. The macro \acmISBN{⟨ISBN⟩} sets it.

macros.name: acmJournal
macros.doc: The macro \acmJournal{⟨shortName⟩} sets the name of the journal or transaction for journals and transactions.

macros.name: acmNumber

macros.name: additionalaffiliation
macros.doc: The command \additionalaffiliation{⟨affiliation⟩} creates a footnote after an author’s name with the words “Also with {⟨affiliation⟩}”.

macros.name: correspondingauthor
macros.doc: The command \correspondingauthor after an author’s name marks the corresponding author.

macros.name: Description

macros.name: grantnum

macros.name: setcctype
macros.doc: If Creative Commons license is used, the package by default chooses CC-BY 4.0 Attribution 4.0 International license. You can override this choice by the command \setcctype[⟨version⟩]{⟨type⟩}, where [⟨version⟩] can be either 3.0 or 4.0 (4.0 by default), and {⟨type⟩} can be one of zero, by, by-sa, by-nd, by-nc, by-nc-sa, by-nc-nd (see https://creativecommons.org/licenses/ for the explanation).

macros.name: settopmatter
macros.doc: Some information in the top matter is printed for certain journals or proceedings and suppressed for others. You can override these defaults using the command \settopmatter{⟨settings⟩}.

macros.name: subtitle
